title: Venetian Masquerade Animator
description: A ShaderBall and a Venice mask orbit each other on a dark stage. The user choreographs their dance by clicking to toggle between animation presets, dragging a slider to control orbit speed, and pressing keys to trigger dramatic pose transitions with easing animations.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements an interactive animation choreography scene. Load both GLB assets using GLTFLoader: ShaderBall.glb and venice_mask.glb from the shared_assets folder. Scene setup: Use a dark background (0x0a0a0f). Place a subtle reflective ground plane. Add a warm SpotLight from above-left and a cool-toned RimLight from behind-right, plus soft ambient light. Position the camera at (0, 2, 6) looking at the origin. Add OrbitControls with damping enabled. Initial layout: Center both models at the origin. Scale them so they are visually balanced. The ShaderBall sits at center and the venice_mask floats slightly above and in front of it. Animation system: Implement 3 animation presets the user cycles through by clicking a styled HTML button labeled 'Dance Mode'. Mode 1 (Orbit): The mask orbits the ShaderBall in a circular path using sin/cos on elapsed time, while the ShaderBall slowly rotates on its Y axis. Mode 2 (Pulse): Both objects scale up and down with a smooth sine-based breathing animation, the mask also tilts side to side. Mode 3 (Spiral): The mask spirals upward around the ShaderBall in a helix path then resets. Add an HTML range slider (min 0.1, max 3.0, step 0.1, default 1.0) that controls the global animation speed multiplier. Implement keyboard interactions: pressing 1, 2, or 3 triggers a smooth transition where both objects lerp to new positions over 1 second using an easeInOutCubic function before starting the selected mode. Pressing Space toggles pause/resume of all animations. Pressing R resets both objects to their initial transforms with a smooth 0.5s tween. Display the current mode name and speed in a semi-transparent overlay in the top-left corner. All transitions should use requestAnimationFrame with delta time. Ensure responsive canvas sizing with a window resize handler.
